reason: The first successful methane record required 367.9 seconds and the already-running benzene record exceeded 17 minutes. Complete-panel wall time under sequential scheduling was therefore impractical for the interactive run.
additional_gate: Every record must retain its own independent model load, MOIST state, work directory, exact cold replay, source hashes, and zero exit status. CUDA OOM, process interference, missing output, or a failed replay gate is a recorded failure and may not be hidden by a parameter change.
claim_boundary: This amendment does not make the panel blind and does not alter the method-level comparison. It only reduces wall time by scheduling independent molecules concurrently.
